about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Finnish Artist and Visual Arts Teacher
about.intro: I am Minna Kattelus, a Finnish artist whose work centers on exploring Nordic light and human emotions through contemporary painting.

journey.title: My Artistic Journey
journey.p1: Born and raised in Finland, my connection with nature and the Finnish landscape was undeniable from a young age. During my childhood, I spent hours observing how the changing light transformed the forests and lakes around me. That early fascination with light and color became the foundation of my artistic practice.
journey.p2: After completing my studies at the Vaasa Academy of Fine Arts, I immersed myself in exploring different techniques and media. It was during my Master's in Fine Arts at the University of Helsinki where I found my unique voice: a fusion of Nordic landscape, emotional abstraction and a color palette inspired by Finnish seasons.
journey.p3: My artistic practice combines traditional techniques with contemporary approaches, working primarily with acrylic and oil on canvas. I firmly believe in the transformative power of art and its ability to connect what surrounds us with our deepest emotions.

teaching.title: Teaching and Vocation
teaching.p1: In addition to my artistic practice, I am a teacher at a vocational center where I share the principle of painting through emotion in a creative landscape. Teaching has enriched me as an artist by being able to transform and share art with my students, fostering creativity and personal expression.
teaching.p2: I firmly believe in the transformative power of art and its ability to connect people with their deepest emotions. In my classes, I encourage students to find their own artistic voice and experiment without fear of mistakes.
teaching.p3: Teaching allows me to give back what art has given me: a way of seeing the world with greater sensitivity and a tool to express the inexpressible.

philosophy.title: My Artistic Philosophy
philosophy.quote: Art is not just about what you see, but what you feel. Each brushstroke is an emotion, each color is a memory, and each work is a window into the soul of the Nordic landscape.
philosophy.text: My work seeks to capture the essence of Finnish landscapes and the emotions they evoke. I don't seek to create literal representations, but emotional interpretations that invite the viewer to their own contemplation. Light, atmosphere and color are my tools to build bridges between the outer world and our inner world.
